title: malpighia coccolobifolia
intro: Malpighia coccolobifolia, commonly known as the West Indian cherry or Coccoloba cherry, is a species of flowering plant in the family Malpighiaceae. This plant is known for its edible fruit and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Malpighia coccolobifolia include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as fever, cough, and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Malpighia coccolobifolia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
